name: Plasma notifications and clipboard in Android
purpose: The Plasma session's notifications in PowOS's shade (a watcher of Plasma's notification server, RegisterWatcher, plus a monitor-only connection for NotificationClosed) and Klipper's clipboard both ways with Android's, text only. Relays through the PowOS app's run dir (plasma/out, plasma/in; PlasmaBridge.kt). D-Bus signals and one inotify watch: idle at rest. Uses the rootfs's own python-dbus and python-gobject; installs no package.
unbounded: one small session process, blocked on D-Bus and inotify at rest; inside the session's own bound (Android's lmkd)
remove: pkill -f powos-plasma-bridge; rm /usr/local/bin/powos-plasma-bridge /etc/xdg/autostart/powos-plasma-bridge.desktop; rm -r /run/powos-app/plasma. Plasma's notifications then stay in Plasma and the clipboard syncs only while the desktop is in front (KWin's own path)
